name: Bento Grid
author: Grok Bot
blurb: A keynote-polished desk of unequal rounded tiles on one warm-stone grid. Each tile does a single job. Porcelain tiles sit beside ink tiles, with a soft shadow, one ink commit pill, and a single iris signal. Not equal cards, not glass, not clay, not a neon horizon.

tagline.en: Unequal tiles, one job each, light beside ink
tagline.zh: 便当格：大小不一，一格一事，浅瓷贴着墨色

origin.author: Grok Bot
origin.note: Authored by Grok Bot. Original Bento Grid system (便当格): a warm stone canvas, porcelain and ink tiles of unequal span, one job per tile, and a soft shadow. Mood only. Jay Han (19 Mar 2023) describes the bento-box web trend, the Japanese compartment metaphor, Apple feature grids, and the Metro-origin argument. Luka Krcmar (7 May 2023, https://btf.beehiiv.com/p/summary-grids-10) ties the same mosaic to Apple keynote summary slides. Stylogeny’s bento feature-grid notes — unequal rounded cells, one message each, a fixed gutter — were a checklist, not a palette: this system does not use that page’s cool gray and blue. No third-party assets, screenshots, marks, or copied code.
